text:
rachael: Hey everyone — please welcome Lana Kim (@lanak) who starts today on Eng Runtime! She'll be working on the inference scheduler and latency SLOs. :tada:
lana kim: hi all! super excited to be here. thanks for the warm welcome. quick Q: who should I ping for a dev laptop image + VPN access?
mike: @lana kim welcome!! I can sort laptop image and VPN. are you mac or linux preference?
lana kim: mac works, but happy to switch to linux if it's better for GPU devs.
devon: hey @lana kim — for GPU stuff we usually remote to dedicated instances, but for local testing we give linux WSL on M1s or ubuntu on Intel. file a ticket in #help if you want the linux image.
onboarding-bot: New hire checklist update: "Lana Kim" added to payroll, slack, google calendar, and github teams. Missing: laptop assignment, 2FA device.
rachael: @mike can you also add Lana to the "eng-runtime" repo and the deployment-staging group?
mike: done, invited to org and added to eng-runtime. you should see an invite email.
jamie: @lana kim ping me for the runbook tour later today — I'll walk through our canary rollout steps and the tracing dashboard. 11am PT ok?
lana kim: 11am works great, thanks @jamie. Also putting a tiny fun fact: I backpacked across Patagonia in 2019.
samir: welcome Lana! fun fact challenge: our team has two other Patagonia fans — you'll fit right in lol.
lana kim: nice! excited to meet you all. one last thing — I tried the internal docs link and got a 403 on the quantization page. who owns docs permissions?
devon: that's probably the docs GCS bucket ACL; @rachael can re-check, or I can escalate to infra.
rachael: I'll take it first; if not resolved by EOD I'll escalate.
onboarding-bot: Reminder: new hire orientation Zoom at 2pm PT. "Lana Kim" is registered.
mike: if you want to try a tiny starter task, see the "warmup - scheduler" issue I assigned to you in eng-runtime. small perf bench and a unit test. no pressure.
lana kim: got it — will look after the orientation. thanks everyone! :wave:
